question: Which of the following is the oldest dated fort in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Kangra Fort**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kangra Fort** is considered the oldest dated fort in India, with references dating back to the Mahabharata period.
 
• The fort is located in the Kangra Valley, in the state of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It was built by the Katoch dynasty, one of the oldest surviving dynasties in the world.
 
• The fort has witnessed numerous invasions, including those by Mahmud of Ghazni and the Mughal emperor Jahangir.
 
• Kangra Fort is renowned for its architectural grandeur and historical significance.
